<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sp_widget"><sp_widget action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><category>custom</category><client_script><![CDATA[api.controller = function($timeout) {
    var c = this;
    var trendChart = null;
    var agingChart = null;

    c.tab = 'portfolio';
    c.search = '';
    c.filters = { segment: 'all', depot: 'all' };
    c.segmentOptions = ['all', 'Cement', 'RMC', 'BPD'];
    c.depotOptions = ['all'];

    c.fmt = function(n) {
        n = parseFloat(n) || 0;
        if (n >= 10000000) return '₹' + (n / 10000000).toFixed(1) + ' Cr';
        if (n >= 100000) return '₹' + (n / 100000).toFixed(1) + 'L';
        if (n >= 1000) return '₹' + (n / 1000).toFixed(0) + 'K';
        return '₹' + n;
    };

    c.statusColor = function(status) {
        return status === 'Blocked' ? 'red' : status === 'Warning' ? 'amber' : 'green';
    };

    c.filteredCustomers = function() {
        var q = (c.search || '').toLowerCase();
        var rows = (c.data.portfolio && c.data.portfolio.rows) || [];
        return rows.filter(function(r) {
            if (c.filters.segment !== 'all' && r.segment !== c.filters.segment) return false;
            if (c.filters.depot !== 'all' && r.depot !== c.filters.depot) return false;
            if (q &&
                (r.code || '').toLowerCase().indexOf(q) === -1 &&
                (r.name || '').toLowerCase().indexOf(q) === -1 &&
                (r.pan || '').toLowerCase().indexOf(q) === -1) return false;
            return true;
        });
    };

    c.switchTab = function(tab) {
        c.tab = tab;
        if (tab === 'portfolio') {
            $timeout(buildAgingChart, 100);
        }
        if (tab === 'approvals') {
            $timeout(buildTrendChart, 100);
        }
    };

    c.openCustomer360 = function(code) {
        c.data.action = 'getCustomer360';
        c.data.code = code;
        c.server.update().then(function() {
            c.tab = 'c360';
        });
    };

    c.openRequestDetail = function(number) {
        c.data.action = 'getRequestDetail';
        c.data.number = number;
        c.server.update().then(function() {
            c.tab = 'reqdetail';
        });
    };

    c.$onInit = function() {
        var depots = {};
        ((c.data.portfolio && c.data.portfolio.rows) || []).forEach(function(r) {
            if (r.depot) depots[r.depot] = true;
        });
        c.depotOptions = ['all'].concat(Object.keys(depots));
        $timeout(buildAgingChart, 500);
    };

    // ---------------------------------------------------------------
    // Chart Definitions
    // ---------------------------------------------------------------
    function buildTrendChart() {
        if (typeof Chart === 'undefined') return;
        var canvas = document.getElementById('clmApprovalTrend');
        if (!canvas) return;
        var trend = (c.data.approvals && c.data.approvals.monthlyTrend) || [];
        if (!trend.length) return;

        var states = {};
        trend.forEach(function(row) {
            for (var k in row) { if (k !== 'month') states[k] = true; }
        });
        var palette = { Submitted: '#1a5ca8', Approved: '#1b7a3e', Pending: '#b45309', Rejected: '#c41c1c' };

        var datasets = Object.keys(states).map(function(state) {
            return {
                label: state,
                data: trend.map(function(row) { return row[state] || 0; }),
                borderColor: palette[state] || '#888',
                backgroundColor: 'transparent',
                tension: 0.3
            };
        });

        if (trendChart) trendChart.destroy();
        trendChart = new Chart(canvas, {
            type: 'line',
            data: { labels: trend.map(function(row) { return row.month; }), datasets: datasets },
            options: { responsive: true, maintainAspectRatio: false, plugins: { legend: { position: 'bottom' } } }
        });
    }

    function buildAgingChart() {
        if (typeof Chart === 'undefined') return;
        var canvas = document.getElementById('cAgingPortfolio');
        if (!canvas) return;

        var ag = c.data.portfolio.agingTotals;
        var datasets = [
            { label: 'Not Due', data: [ag.notDue], backgroundColor: '#1b7a3e' },
            { label: '0-30D', data: [ag.d0_30], backgroundColor: '#f5c400' },
            { label: '31-60D', data: [ag.d31_60], backgroundColor: '#b45309' },
            { label: '61-90D', data: [ag.d61_90], backgroundColor: '#c41c1c' },
            { label: '>90D', data: [ag.gt90], backgroundColor: '#7f1d1d' }
        ];

        if (agingChart) agingChart.destroy();
        agingChart = new Chart(canvas, {
            type: 'bar',
            data: { labels: ['Current Portfolio Aging'], datasets: datasets },
            options: { responsive: true, maintainAspectRatio: false, indexAxis: 'y', scales: { x: { stacked: true }, y: { stacked: true } } }
        });
    }
};]]></client_script><controller_as>c</controller_as><css>.clm-dash {
  font-family: 'Inter', -apple-system, sans-serif;
  font-size: 13px;
  color: #1d2125;
  background: #f2f4f7;
  min-height: 100vh;

  --accent: #1a5ca8;
  --red: #c41c1c;
  --green: #1b7a3e;
  --amber: #b45309;
  --teal: #107e7d;
  --border: #d5d8e0;
  --muted: #6b7585;

  .sn-topbar { height: 48px; background: #1a1a1a; border-bottom: 3px solid #f5c400; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; padding: 0 16px; margin-bottom: 16px; }
  .sn-topbar-user { font-size: 11px; color: rgba(255,255,255,.7); font-weight: 600; }
  .sn-logo-badge { background: #f5c400; border-radius: 3px; padding: 3px 8px; }
  .sn-logo-text { font-size: 13px; font-weight: 800; color: #1a1a1a; line-height: 1; }
  .sn-logo-sub { font-size: 8px; font-weight: 700; color: #1a1a1a; letter-spacing: .08em; }
  .sn-topbar-title { font-size: 12px; color: rgba(255,255,255,.6); margin-left: 6px; }
  .sn-topbar-module { font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; color: #fff; margin-left: 6px; }

  .clm-tabs {
    display: flex; list-style: none; margin: 0 20px 16px; padding: 0; border-bottom: 2px solid var(--border); background: #fff;
    li a { display: block; padding: 10px 18px; font-weight: 500; color: var(--muted); text-decoration: none; cursor: pointer; border-bottom: 3px solid transparent; margin-bottom: -2px; }
    li.active a { color: #1a1a1a; font-weight: 600; border-bottom-color: #f5c400; }
  }

  .sn-panel { padding: 0 20px 20px; }

  .clm-filter-strip {
    background: #fff; border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 6px; padding: 10px 16px; margin-bottom: 16px; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; flex-wrap: wrap;
  }
  .clm-filter-label { font-size: 11px; font-weight: 700; color: var(--muted); text-transform: uppercase; }
  .clm-select, .clm-search { border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 4px; padding: 5px 8px; font-size: 12px; font-family: inherit; }
  .clm-filter-summary { margin-left: auto; font-size: 11px; color: var(--muted); }

  .kpi-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(180px, 1fr)); gap: 12px; margin-bottom: 16px; }
  .kpi-card { background: #fff; border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 6px; padding: 14px; }
  .kpi-name { font-size: 10px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--muted); text-transform: uppercase; margin-bottom: 6px; }
  .kpi-value { font-size: 22px; font-weight: 700; }
  .kpi-sub { font-size: 11px; color: var(--muted); margin-top: 4px; }

  .sc-blue  { border-left: 4px solid var(--accent); .kpi-value { color: var(--accent); } }
  .sc-amber { border-left: 4px solid var(--amber);  .kpi-value { color: var(--amber); } }
  .sc-green { border-left: 4px solid var(--green);  .kpi-value { color: var(--green); } }
  .sc-red   { border-left: 4px solid var(--red);    .kpi-value { color: var(--red); } }
  .sc-teal  { border-left: 4px solid var(--teal);   .kpi-value { color: var(--teal); } }

  .chart-grid-3 { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 12px; margin-bottom: 16px; }
  .full-span { grid-column: 1 / -1; }

  .clm-chart-card { background: #fff; border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 6px; padding: 14px; margin-bottom: 16px; }
  .clm-chart-title { font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; margin-bottom: 10px; }
  .clm-chart-wrap { position: relative; height: 160px; }

  .clm-table {
    width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; background: #fff; border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 6px; overflow: hidden;
    th { text-align: left; padding: 8px 12px; font-size: 10px; font-weight: 700; color: var(--muted); text-transform: uppercase; background: #f8f9fa; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border); }
    td { padding: 9px 12px; border-bottom: 1px solid #f0f2f5; font-size: 12px; }
    tr { cursor: pointer; }
    tr:hover td { background: #f5f7ff; }
  }

  .chip { display: inline-block; padding: 2px 7px; border-radius: 3px; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 600; background: #dbeafe; color: #1d4ed8; }
  .chip-green { background: #dcfce7; color: #166534; }
  .chip-amber { background: #fef9c3; color: #92400e; }
  .chip-red   { background: #fee2e2; color: #991b1b; }

  .seg-chip { font-size: 10px; padding: 1px 5px; border-radius: 3px; font-weight: 700; }
  .seg-cement { background: #ede9fe; color: #5b21b6; }
  .seg-rmc    { background: #d1fae5; color: #065f46; }
  .seg-bpd    { background: #fef9c3; color: #78350f; }

  .util-wrap { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; }
  .util-bar { flex: 1; height: 4px; background: #e5e7eb; border-radius: 2px; }
  .util-fill { height: 100%; border-radius: 2px; }

  .empty-state { padding: 40px; text-align: center; color: var(--muted); font-size: 12px; line-height: 1.6; }
  .empty-state code { background: #eef0f3; padding: 1px 6px; border-radius: 3px; font-size: 11px; }
  .btn-back { background: #fff; border: 1px solid var(--border); padding: 6px 12px; border-radius: 4px; cursor: pointer; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 600; }

  .justification-box { margin: 14px 0; }
  .justification-box label { font-size: 11px; font-weight: 700; color: var(--muted); display: block; margin-bottom: 4px; }
  .justification-box p { padding: 10px 12px; background: #f8f9fa; border-left: 3px solid var(--accent); font-size: 12px; line-height: 1.6; margin: 0; }
}</css><data_table>sp_instance</data_table><demo_data/><description/><docs/><field_list/><has_preview>true</has_preview><id>copy_of_clmtrade</id><internal>false</internal><link><![CDATA[function link(scope, element, attrs, controller) {  }]]></link><name>copy of clmtrade</name><option_schema/><public>false</public><roles/><script><![CDATA[(function() {
    /* ============================================================
       CLM PORTFOLIO DASHBOARD — Server Script (TSH-scoped)
       ============================================================
       Each logged-in TSH sees only:
         - Customers where Customer Master's `tsh` field = them
         - Requests where Credit Request's `initiator` field = them
       Matched against sys_id / display name / login name together,
       since reference fields can resolve inconsistently depending
       on how the record was created (mirrors the OR-pattern already
       used for `initiator` in the View My Requests widget).
    ============================================================ */

    var TABLE_CUSTOMER = 'x_birl3_clm_clm_customer_master1';
    var TABLE_REQUEST  = 'x_birl3_clm_clm_new_credit_request';
    var TABLE_AGING    = 'x_birl3_clm_clm_aging_snapshot';
    var TABLE_APPROVAL = 'sysapproval_approver';

    var CUST_FIELDS = {
        name:        'customer_name',
        code:        'customer_code_sap',
        pan:         'pan',
        segment:     'segment',
        sd:          'current_sd_amount',
        limit:       'current_credit_limit',
        active:      'is_active',
        blockStatus: 'credit_block_status',
        tsh:         'tsh',
        depot:       'depot',
        avgSales:    'avg_monthly_sales_mt'
    };

    var REQ_FIELDS = {
        customer:               'customer',
        segment:                'segment',
        state:                  'state',
        requested:              'requested_limit',
        approved:               'approved_limit',
        outstanding:            'outstanding_amount',
        netExposure:            'net_exposure',
        safeLimit:              'safe_allowable_limit',
        isDeviation:            'is_deviation',
        deviationJustification: 'deviation_justification',
        businessJustification:  'business_justification',
        initiator:              'initiator',
        approver:               'approver',
        reqApproverLevel:       'required_approver_level',
        requestNumber:          'number'
    };

    var data = data || {};

    // Exposed so the widget can show "Viewing as: <name>" — useful while
    // testing scoping, since an empty dashboard and a correctly-scoped
    // empty dashboard look identical otherwise.
    data.currentUser = {
        id:   gs.getUserID(),
        name: gs.getUserDisplayName()
    };

    if (input && input.action === 'getCustomer360') {
        data.customer360 = getCustomer360(input.code);
    } else if (input && input.action === 'getRequestDetail') {
        data.requestDetail = getRequestDetail(input.number);
    } else {
        data.portfolio = buildPortfolio();
        data.approvals = buildApprovals();
    }

    // ---------------------------------------------------------------
    // SCOPING HELPER
    // ---------------------------------------------------------------
    // Adds an OR-condition group to `gr` matching the current user
    // against `field` by sys_id, display name, and login name.
    function scopeToCurrentUser(gr, field) {
        var uid   = gs.getUserID();
        var dname = gs.getUserDisplayName();
        var lname = gs.getUserName();

        var qc = gr.addQuery(field, uid);
        qc.addOrCondition(field, dname);
        qc.addOrCondition(field, lname);
        return qc;
    }

    // ---------------------------------------------------------------
    // PORTFOLIO OVERVIEW — scoped to customers where tsh = current user
    // ---------------------------------------------------------------
    function buildPortfolio() {
        var rows = [];
        var totals = { limit: 0, os: 0, customers: 0, overdue90: 0 };
        var agingTotals = { notDue: 0, d0_30: 0, d31_60: 0, d61_90: 0, gt90: 0 };

        var gr = new GlideRecord(TABLE_CUSTOMER);
        gr.addQuery(CUST_FIELDS.active, 'true'); // FIX: string, not JS boolean — true_false fields store 'true'/'false'
        scopeToCurrentUser(gr, CUST_FIELDS.tsh);
        gr.query();

        while (gr.next()) {
            var sysId = gr.getUniqueValue();
            var limit = parseFloat(gr.getValue(CUST_FIELDS.limit) || 0);

            var aging = getAgingData(sysId);
            var os = aging ? aging.total : 0;

            var status = gr.getValue(CUST_FIELDS.blockStatus) ? 'Blocked' : 'Active';

            rows.push({
                sys_id:      sysId,
                code:        gr.getValue(CUST_FIELDS.code),
                name:        gr.getValue(CUST_FIELDS.name),
                pan:         gr.getValue(CUST_FIELDS.pan),
                segment:     gr.getDisplayValue(CUST_FIELDS.segment),
                depot:       gr.getDisplayValue(CUST_FIELDS.depot),
                limit:       limit,
                outstanding: os,
                available:   Math.max(0, limit - os),
                utilisation: limit > 0 ? Math.round((os / limit) * 100) : 0,
                status:      status,
                od90:        aging ? aging.gt90 : 0
            });

            totals.limit += limit;
            totals.os += os;
            totals.customers++;
            if (aging) {
                totals.overdue90 += aging.gt90;
                agingTotals.notDue += aging.notDue;
                agingTotals.d0_30  += aging.d0_30;
                agingTotals.d31_60 += aging.d31_60;
                agingTotals.d61_90 += aging.d61_90;
                agingTotals.gt90   += aging.gt90;
            }
        }

        return { rows: rows, totals: totals, agingTotals: agingTotals };
    }

    // ---------------------------------------------------------------
    // APPROVAL REQUESTS — scoped to requests where initiator = current user
    // ---------------------------------------------------------------
    function buildApprovals() {
        var rows = [];
        var counts = {};
        var monthly = {};

        var gr = new GlideRecord(TABLE_REQUEST);
        scopeToCurrentUser(gr, REQ_FIELDS.initiator);
        gr.orderByDesc('sys_created_on');
        gr.setLimit(200);
        gr.query();

        while (gr.next()) {
            var state = gr.getDisplayValue(REQ_FIELDS.state);
            counts[state] = (counts[state] || 0) + 1;

            var created = gr.getValue('sys_created_on') || '';
            var monthKey = created.substring(0, 7);
            if (monthKey) {
                if (!monthly[monthKey]) monthly[monthKey] = {};
                monthly[monthKey][state] = (monthly[monthKey][state] || 0) + 1;
            }

            rows.push({
                sys_id:       gr.getUniqueValue(),
                number:       gr.getValue(REQ_FIELDS.requestNumber),
                customer:     gr.getDisplayValue(REQ_FIELDS.customer),
                customerName: gr.customer.customer_name.toString(),
                segment:      gr.getDisplayValue(REQ_FIELDS.segment),
                state:        state,
                requested:    parseFloat(gr.getValue(REQ_FIELDS.requested) || 0),
                approved:     gr.getValue(REQ_FIELDS.approved) ? parseFloat(gr.getValue(REQ_FIELDS.approved)) : null,
                outstanding:  parseFloat(gr.getValue(REQ_FIELDS.outstanding) || 0),
                isDeviation:  gr.getValue(REQ_FIELDS.isDeviation) == '1' || gr.getValue(REQ_FIELDS.isDeviation) == 'true'
            });
        }

        var trend = Object.keys(monthly).sort().map(function(m) {
            var row = { month: m };
            for (var st in monthly[m]) row[st] = monthly[m][st];
            return row;
        });

        return { rows: rows, counts: counts, monthlyTrend: trend };
    }

    // ---------------------------------------------------------------
    // CUSTOMER 360 & REQUEST DETAIL
    // ---------------------------------------------------------------
    // NOTE: these are NOT re-scoped to current user. They only ever run
    // against a code/number that came from the already-scoped lists
    // above (the user clicked a row they were already allowed to see).
    function getCustomer360(code) {
        var gr = new GlideRecord(TABLE_CUSTOMER);
        gr.addQuery(CUST_FIELDS.code, code);
        gr.query();
        if (!gr.next()) return null;

        var profile = {};
        for (var key in CUST_FIELDS) {
            profile[key] = gr.getDisplayValue(CUST_FIELDS[key]);
        }
        profile.sys_id = gr.getUniqueValue();
        profile.status = gr.getValue(CUST_FIELDS.blockStatus) ? 'Blocked' : 'Active';

        profile.aging = getAgingData(profile.sys_id);

        var history = [];
        var rgr = new GlideRecord(TABLE_REQUEST);
        rgr.addQuery(REQ_FIELDS.customer, profile.sys_id);
        rgr.orderByDesc('sys_created_on');
        rgr.query();
        while (rgr.next()) {
            history.push({
                number:    rgr.getValue(REQ_FIELDS.requestNumber),
                state:     rgr.getDisplayValue(REQ_FIELDS.state),
                requested: parseFloat(rgr.getValue(REQ_FIELDS.requested) || 0),
                approved:  rgr.getValue(REQ_FIELDS.approved) ? parseFloat(rgr.getValue(REQ_FIELDS.approved)) : null,
                created:   rgr.getValue('sys_created_on')
            });
        }
        profile.requestHistory = history;
        return profile;
    }

    function getRequestDetail(number) {
        var gr = new GlideRecord(TABLE_REQUEST);
        gr.addQuery(REQ_FIELDS.requestNumber, number);
        gr.query();
        if (!gr.next()) return null;

        var detail = {};
        for (var key in REQ_FIELDS) {
            detail[key] = gr.getDisplayValue(REQ_FIELDS[key]);
        }
        detail.sys_id = gr.getUniqueValue();
        detail.isDeviation = gr.getValue(REQ_FIELDS.isDeviation) == '1' || gr.getValue(REQ_FIELDS.isDeviation) == 'true';

        var trail = [];
        var appGr = new GlideRecord(TABLE_APPROVAL);
        appGr.addQuery('document_id', detail.sys_id);
        appGr.orderBy('sys_created_on');
        appGr.query();
        while (appGr.next()) {
            trail.push({
                approver: appGr.getDisplayValue('approver'),
                state:    appGr.getDisplayValue('state'),
                comments: appGr.getValue('comments'),
                updated:  appGr.getValue('sys_updated_on')
            });
        }
        detail.approvalTrail = trail;

        return detail;
    }

    // ---------------------------------------------------------------
    // HELPER: AGING ROLLUP
    // ---------------------------------------------------------------
    function getAgingData(customerSysId) {
        var gr = new GlideRecord(TABLE_AGING);
        gr.addQuery('customer', customerSysId);
        gr.orderByDesc('sys_created_on');
        gr.setLimit(1);
        gr.query();
        if (!gr.next()) return null;

        var total = parseFloat(gr.getValue('total_outstanding') || 0);

        var b0_30   = parseFloat(gr.getValue('bucket_0_30_days') || 0);
        var b31_45  = parseFloat(gr.getValue('bucket_31_45_days') || 0);
        var b46_60  = parseFloat(gr.getValue('bucket_46_60_days') || 0);
        var b61_75  = parseFloat(gr.getValue('bucket_61_75_days') || 0);
        var b76_90  = parseFloat(gr.getValue('bucket_76_90_days') || 0);
        var b91_120 = parseFloat(gr.getValue('bucket_91_120_days') || 0);
        var bGt120  = parseFloat(gr.getValue('bucket_gt120_days') || 0);

        var d31_60 = b31_45 + b46_60;
        var d61_90 = b61_75 + b76_90;
        var gt90   = b91_120 + bGt120;

        var overdueSum = b0_30 + d31_60 + d61_90 + gt90;
        var notDue = Math.max(0, total - overdueSum);

        return {
            snapshotMonth: gr.getDisplayValue('snapshot_month'),
            total:  total,
            notDue: notDue,
            d0_30:  b0_30,
            d31_60: d31_60,
            d61_90: d61_90,
            gt90:   gt90
        };
    }

})();]]></script><servicenow>false</servicenow><sys_class_name>sp_widget</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>vedant.salunke@mindsprint.com</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-03-27 05:00:54</sys_created_on><sys_id>fcc2f2fa2b3bb6d04572f3745e91bf1a</sys_id><sys_mod_count>6</sys_mod_count><sys_name>copy of clmtrade</sys_name><sys_package display_value="CLM" source="x_birl3_clm">d01e8ce22bb27e104572f3745e91bfe3</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="CLM">d01e8ce22bb27e104572f3745e91bfe3</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sp_widget_fcc2f2fa2b3bb6d04572f3745e91bf1a</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>vedant.salunke@mindsprint.com</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-06-19 05:19:52</sys_updated_on><template><![CDATA[<script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/chart.js@4.4.0/dist/chart.umd.min.js"></script>
